ideas.pitch: A real-time fact-checking and policy-conflict detection engine designed to assist parliamentary debaters during live AI policy negotiations.
ideas.problem_statement: AI policy debate and consensus building under the AI Sansad parliamentary framework.
ideas.title: DebateSync AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the unique parliamentary debate and technical argumentation format of AI Sansad, helping debaters identify logical gaps and factual contradictions in opposing arguments on the fly.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent argumentation mapper that aggregates competing technical proposals and simulates downstream policy consensus outcomes.
ideas.problem_statement: Working toward collective consensus on complex artificial intelligence and machine learning innovations.
ideas.title: ConsensusGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced graph intelligence and multi-agent reasoning to mimic the core evaluation criteria of AI Sansad judges—namely, evaluating trade-offs and reaching structured consensus.

ideas.pitch: A calibrated forecasting platform that evaluates the systemic societal risk of proposed AI deployment policies using probabilistic regression and backtested indicators.
ideas.problem_statement: Evaluating long-term safety, risk, and regulatory impacts of artificial intelligence innovations.
ideas.title: AIGovern Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes rigorous statistical modeling and calibrated prediction intervals, mirroring winning architectures from specialized AI safety and forecasting hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated compliance and risk investigation platform that audits AI model architectures against hypothetical regulatory frameworks.
ideas.problem_statement: Demonstrating technical capabilities and defending AI approaches through structured documentation and rebuttal preparation.
ideas.title: PolicyAudit AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides judges with an instant, explainable breakdown of model compliance, addressing the exact accountability and transparency challenges emphasized in technical MUNs.

ideas.pitch: A benchmarking proxy tool that evaluates competing AI solution architectures based on efficiency, robustness, and argumentative strength.
ideas.problem_statement: Critically evaluating competing ideas and justifying technical decisions during parliamentary defense rounds.
ideas.title: ArgueBench
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven benchmarking paradigms to pit different algorithmic approaches against each other, giving teams an empirical edge during questioning and rebuttal sessions.
